This source package includes the fixed-commit source subset required by the firmware. SOURCE_NOTICE.md and UPSTREAM_SOURCE.txt retain attribution and upstream revisions. References in the notice to the broader corpus do not imply that audio fixtures, training data, tests, or all upstream files are included here. The Apache license and both original and patched-copy KissFFT BSD terms are included at the paths named in the notice and in the corresponding patched source directory. Existing source-file copyright and license notices remain intact.
